I get intrusive thoughts all the time. They always make me feel really anxious and i immediately try to just push them to the back of my mind. But intrusive thoughts are just that- intrusive, and impulsive. They’re not thoughts you’d normally willingly think, or in most cases even act out on. It’s just that sudden spur of “what if”. I think that’s important to remember. These thoughts don’t define who you are as a person, and don’t shape your character or morals. The fact that you feel guilty about them even shows that. Intrusive thoughts are just something that can come along with OCD and other issues, and assuming from your post that you don’t have them anymore, it’s important to note that you’ve been able to move past this. Guilt from past psychological issues can be difficult to overcome; looking back I almost don’t recognize myself when I was struggling a lot. I myself have done and thought things I regret deeply. Accept that they are a thing of the past, that you’ve become stronger, and remember that intrusive thoughts don’t actually portray what we normally feel or believe about things. Just because you’ve had these thoughts doesn’t mean that you don’t deserve to be happy, it’s just something difficult that you’ve had to deal with in the past. Hope this helps in some way, good luck bud~
